source_details.title: Meet Joe Black
source_details.synopsis: Meet Joe Black is a 1998 American romantic fantasy drama film directed and produced by Martin Brest, from a screenplay by Bo Goldman, Kevin Wade, Ron Osborn, and Jeff Reno. It stars Brad Pitt, Anthony Hopkins, and Claire Forlani, and is based on the 1934 film Death Takes a Holiday. The story follows media mogul Bill Parrish, who is approached by Death shortly before his 65th birthday. Death assumes the body of a young man previously encountered by Parrish's daughter Susan and agrees to postpone Bill's death in exchange for being shown what it is like to live as a human, while developing a relationship with Susan.
